Label: relative frequency
Definition: The number of co-occurrences of a word x and its collocate y divided by the number of occurrences of x: f(xy) / f(x). Asymmetric, so the collocation must identify its head x.

Label: pointwise mutual information
Definition: The binary logarithm of the ratio between the observed and expected co-occurrence frequency of two words: log2(f(xy) N / (f(x) f(y))), where N is the size of the corpus. Also known as MI-score or association ratio (Church and Hanks 1990).

Label: PMI² score
Definition: A variant of pointwise mutual information that squares the co-occurrence frequency to reduce the bias towards rare words: log2(f(xy)² N / (f(x) f(y))).

Label: PMI³ score
Definition: A variant of pointwise mutual information that cubes the co-occurrence frequency to reduce the bias towards rare words: log2(f(xy)³ N / (f(x) f(y))) (Daille 1994).

Label: PMI.log-f
Definition: Pointwise mutual information multiplied by the logarithm of the co-occurrence frequency: log2(f(xy) N / (f(x) f(y))) × log f(xy). Also known as salience.

Label: Dice coefficient
Definition: Twice the number of co-occurrences of two words divided by the sum of their frequencies: 2 f(xy) / (f(x) + f(y)).

Label: logDice
Definition: 14 plus the binary logarithm of the Dice coefficient: 14 + log2(2 f(xy) / (f(x) + f(y))) (Rychlý 2008).

Label: minimum sensitivity
Definition: The smaller of the two relative frequencies of a pair of words: min(f(xy) / f(x), f(xy) / f(y)) (Pedersen 1998).

Label: log-likelihood
Definition: The log-likelihood ratio test statistic (G²) for the independence of two words, computed from their contingency table of observed and expected frequencies (Dunning 1993).

Label: t-score
Definition: Student's t test statistic for the co-occurrence of two words: (f(xy) - f(x) f(y) / N) / √f(xy) (Church et al. 1991).

Label: chi-square
Definition: Pearson's chi-square test statistic for the independence of two words, computed from their 2×2 contingency table: N (O11 O22 - O12 O21)² / ((O11 + O12)(O11 + O21)(O12 + O22)(O21 + O22)).

Label: support
Definition: For an association rule between two words, the proportion of contexts in which both occur: f(xy) / N.

Label: lift
Definition: For an association rule between two words, how many times more often they occur together than expected if they were statistically independent: f(xy) N / (f(x) f(y)). Also known as interest.

Label: conviction
Definition: For an association rule from x to y, the ratio of the expected frequency of x occurring without y, if they were independent, to the observed frequency of such errors: (1 - f(y) / N) / (1 - f(xy) / f(x)).
